ov: Four species of fast, highly venomous African snakes in the cobra family. Three are green and live in trees; the black mamba is brown or grey and lives mostly on the ground. All hunt by day, and the World Health Organization classes all four as snakes of medical importance.

why.dg: Highly venomous, but a black mamba attacks people only when it is threatened or cornered.

len: Black mamba: usually 2–3 m; up to 4.5 m reported
fx: The black mamba is the second-longest venomous snake, after the king cobra.
Stories of black mambas chasing people are common, but they usually avoid humans and flee to their lair.
